rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.1, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-5 INIT_T lever (push lower), breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: init_t sweep at relax1.0: 0.7->PSNR16.5, 0.4->19.4, 0.2->22.0, RMSE 5.12e-2->3.66e-2->2.70e-2. STRICTLY MONOTONIC: every init_t drop helps. baseline PSNR36.3/RMSE5.21e-3, hr=0 so far. (2) FAILURE MODE: even at init_t=0.2 the wavelet-prior embed still degrades the strong 128-view breast FBP; the prior is not yet a near-identity light denoiser. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.2 -> 0.1 (FBP embedded very close to clean; prior barely perturbs it). (4) HYPOTHESIS: init_t=0.1 continues the RMSE-down trend toward the FBP floor; at very low init_t the recon approaches (light-denoised FBP -> CG-DC), which should approach or clear the baseline. FALSIFIER: if PSNR still <<36 even at init_t=0.1, the 8-step wavelet prior CANNOT match the 128-view breast FBP (it always injects net-harmful structure), meaning this DC-on wavelet variant is FBP-bounded here regardless of init_t -> pivot iters to steps/n_cg and then conclude. (5) BUDGET: ~90s/iter. (6) Loop continues; iter-6 on landing.
